businessProblem: Deccan Chronicle Holdings Ltd. requires immediate diagnosis of root causes and a highest-priority action plan given failure to pay debenture principal and interest obligations as of 26 July 2012, alongside weak cash conversion, working-capital stress, and deteriorating creditor confidence.

evidence.finding: Failure to pay principal and interest on debenture redemption obligations as of 26 July 2012
evidence.source: Public legal records and debenture trustee documentation

evidence.finding: Weak cash conversion from media and publishing operations insufficient to cover debt service and working-capital needs simultaneously
Working-capital stress alongside debt service obligations; no concluded creditor standstill or restructuring arrangement
Creditor trust deteriorating following missed debenture obligations; formal creditor enforcement action risk elevated
Possible overextension into non-core activities draining cash available for core media operations and debt service
Board oversight of financial obligations and debt management inadequate; insufficient proactive creditor communication

clientContext.size: Established media and publishing group with regional and national presence
clientContext.revenueImpactUrgency: Critical - debenture default, creditor enforcement risk, working-capital stress
